title: cosmos parametric_looks
description: Hand-authored looks built from blocks, and the ported looks they retire. Kept apart from looks.json because that file is generated.

block.description: the name of a block in engine/blocks.py, e.g. "orbit" or "hue_cycle"

groups.description: which rig groups this writes, e.g. ["corner movers"]. A movement look with none moves the movers; any other look, everything

supersedes.description: true to take over the ported look of this name; it must reproduce it exactly

replaced_by.description: the look that covers this one now, so the picker can point at it

version.description: Format version. Current is 1; a file with no version is treated as 1.
